lines.text: Marked. The Wardens hunt colours. It does not. Sit a while; nothing in here will shoot you.
Halvard. Anselm's people. Tell him the fault is singing. He knows the tune.
Child. Sit, or stand; it hears you either way. Most people prefer to sit.
A different tune. Yes. Your beacon records one coming back. The beacon calls it close. We have not named what sets its delay.
A familiar voice. An unfamiliar label. That is what the copied echo gives us. We can listen without making the label its name.
A wrong name. The third listener writes it down that way. We have the mismatch, not the mouth that made it.
Out of phase. Yes. Three cells carry the decant frequency in your readings. We hear the pattern; we have not earned its name.
You are new. It likes the new ones. The vats hum when you are decanted and it hums back. Did they tell you that?
A choice. Yes. The Chronicle records a choice. We have not finished listening.
Child. Sit, or stand; it hears you either way. Most people prefer to sit.

barks.text: Nine of us heard it first. Three of us are left. The number was never the point.
